content.description:
Wayup is a web3 marketplace that looks to push the boundaries of innovation and collaboration.

By providing a feature rich platform, based around user experience, we plan on changing the landscape of marketplaces and how they are viewed in the web3 space.

Our platform will encourage users to trade NFTs, and eventually other assets, by focusing on ease of use and rewarding said use.
